exposure: Near delivery ultrasound estimated fetal weight
cohort: Women with gestational diabetes who had an ultrasound estimated fetal weight (EFW) between 34(0/7) and 36(6/7) weeks and an additional ultrasound EFW within 7 d of delivery at term
finding: The gestation-adjusted projection (GAP) method is as accurate as term ultrasound in predicting birth weight in women with gestational diabetes.
